top_signals.title: Treasuries Weaken as Soaring Oil Prices Revive Rate Hike Worries
top_signals.summary: Treasuries fell as traders worried that rising oil prices will fan inflation and add to pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Diesel Crunch Set to Worsen as Refining Capacity Falls Short, Industry Warns
top_signals.summary: The tight global diesel market is set to further tighten in the coming months and keep fuel prices high, raising the prices of all goods and threatening the inflation targets of the central banks. Industry officials, who gathered at the APPEC petroleum conference in Singapore this week, warned that the market has not seen the worst of the diesel crisis yet. Analysts say the real stress in oil markets is in the diesel market right now. Global fuel markets are very tight and inflexible, despite the higher crude oil flows out of the Persian Gulf in…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
